run_name.title: Run label
run_name.description: Optional label used as the output prefix; defaults to the uploaded file name without extension.

abundance_threshold.title: Unique sequence abundance threshold
abundance_threshold.description: Minimum count retained during AIRR formatting (format_labeling_imgt_airr.py -t).

top_clones.title: Top clones for trees
top_clones.description: Number of top clones to analyze (top_clones.py -s / setting NUMBER_TOP_CLONE).

clonotypes_per_clone.title: Clonotypes per clone
clonotypes_per_clone.description: Comma/space-separated clonotype counts per selected clone (e.g. "30, 200" or "all").

use_refinement.title: Run refinement step
use_refinement.description: Run refinement.py before two-level clonotype grouping.

merge_singleton.title: Merge singleton clones
merge_singleton.description: Allow refinement to merge singleton clusters (setting MERGE_SINGLETON).

clonotype_method.title: Clonotype definition method
clonotype_method.description: Two-level clonotype method: L1, L2, L3, L4, or L5.

clonotype_similarity_threshold.title: Clonotype similarity threshold
clonotype_similarity_threshold.description: Similarity threshold used by methods L4 and L5.
